info.name: YugabyteDB Aeon REST Access Keys Restores API

params.name: accountId
params.description: The unique identifier of the YugabyteDB Aeon account.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The unique identifier of the project within the account.

params.name: clusterId
params.description: The unique identifier of the cluster.

params.name: backupId
params.description: The unique identifier of the backup snapshot.

items.docs: Restores the specified cluster from a previously created backup. The restore operation overwrites the current cluster data with the state captured in the backup snapshot.
